def _cart_position(event, item, membership=None, **kwargs):
    return CartPosition(event=event, item=item, price=Decimal('23.00'), used_membership=membership, **kwargs)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, lock=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_no_requirement(event, customer):
    item = Item.objects.create(event=event, name='Plain', default_price=Decimal('23.00'))
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, item)], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_required_but_missing(event, customer, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'requires an active membership' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_set_but_not_required(event, customer, membership):
    item = Item.objects.create(event=event, name='Plain', default_price=Decimal('23.00'))
    cp = _cart_position(event, item, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'does not require a membership' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_other_customer(event, customer, requiring_ticket, membership_type):
    other = event.organizer.customers.create(email="jane@example.org")
    other_membership = other.memberships.create(

        date_start=datetime(2021, 4, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ),
        date_end=datetime(2021, 4, 30, 23, 59, 59, 999999, tzinfo=TZ),
    )
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, other_membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'different customer account' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_canceled(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.canceled = True
    membership.save()
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'has been canceled' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_type_not_allowed(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    requiring_ticket.require_membership_types.clear()
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'is not allowed for the product' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_testmode_mismatch(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    membership.testmode = True
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, testmode=False)
    assert 'can not use a test mode membership' in str(excinfo.value.message)

    membership.testmode = False
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, testmode=True)
    assert 'need to add a test mode membership' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_not_valid_for_event(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.date_start = datetime(2021, 3, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ)

    membership.save()
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'an event taking place at' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_not_valid_for_ticket_validity(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership, override_valid_from=datetime(2021, 5, 1, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ))
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'starts to be valid on' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_variation_requirement(event, customer, membership, membership_type):
    item = Item.objects.create(event=event, name='Plain', default_price=Decimal('23.00'))
    var = item.variations.create(value='Member', require_membership=True)
    var.require_membership_types.add(membership_type)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, item, membership, variation=var)], event)

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, item, variation=var)], event)
    assert 'requires an active membership' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages(event, customer, membership, membership_type, requiring_ticket):
    membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership_type.save()
    order = Order.objects.create(event=event, status=Order.STATUS_PAID, expires=now() + timedelta(days=3),
                                 sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"), total=23)
    OrderPosition.objects.create(order=order, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)

    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'more than 1 times' in str(excinfo.value.message)

    # The order being changed does not count against the limit
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, ignored_order=order)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_overlapping_in_same_purchase(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp2 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)
    assert 'at the same time' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_overlapping_ticket_validity(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    def cp(start, end):
        return _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership,
                              override_valid_from=datetime(2021, 4, 27, start, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ),
                              override_valid_until=datetime(2021, 4, 27, end, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ))

    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp(10, 12), cp(13, 14)], event)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp(10, 12), cp(11, 14)], event)
    assert 'overlaps with this time frame' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_overlapping_existing_order(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    order = Order.objects.create(event=event, status=Order.STATUS_PAID, expires=now() + timedelta(days=3),
                                 sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"), total=23)
    OrderPosition.objects.create(order=order, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)

    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'at the same time' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid_from_not_chosen(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp2 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)

    # Overlapping tickets are only checked once the validity has been chosen
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp, cp2], event, valid_from_not_chosen=True)

    membership.date_end = datetime(2021, 4, 30, 23, 59, 59, 999999, tzinfo=TZ)
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, valid_from_not_chosen=True)
    assert 'no longer valid' in str(excinfo.value.message)
'''
